overall_summary: Data sample is small (10 videos). Husband-Wife and relationship dynamic topics heavily outperform sibling/family generic poetry. We will build on relationship dynamics with controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' received 1,662 views and 50 likes, far outperforming the channel average (~330 views).
winning_patterns.action: Focus on subtle marital and long-term relationship emotional misunderstandings.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' achieved 371 views and 13 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Use real-life daily friction points in romantic relationships instead of broad poetic statements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister videos scored 18 and 134 views; Brother video scored 109 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pause generic sibling appreciation posts until base audience is established.

next_video.concept: A spouse coming home tired and staying quiet isn't losing love, but carrying unsaid mental weight.
next_video.opening_direction: Show a partner sitting quietly in the balcony late evening after a long day without checking their phone.
next_video.twist_direction: The silence wasn't anger toward the partner, but trying not to pass on the day's stress to the person they love most.
next_video.reason: The top performing video centered on Husband-Wife understanding posted at 07:28 AM UTC.

experiment: Testing if silent sacrifice/understanding in couples drives higher save and share rates than direct advice format.
